title: Sit-in by the Justice Ministry union collective over workplace and administrative grievances
location: Ministry of Justice and Legislation, Cotonou; exact area within ministry and public access are not stated
scope: A ministry justice union collective held a sit-in in the ministry courtyard on 7 Oct, as independently described by S001 and S007; a separate notice S008 was only advance planning. Neither occurrence source reports a simultaneous count. Public access to the courtyard remains unclear.
organizer: Collectif des syndicats du ministère de la Justice; S007 identifies the union college and its spokesperson.
threshold_50_evidence: No source provides a participant estimate or count. The collective is a union group but group membership is not event attendance; threshold remains unverified.

start_date.summary: La Nouvelle Tribune reports the collective observed a sit-in on Monday 7 Oct; same-day Bénin Web TV result also reports it observed that Monday.

end_date.summary: The report dates the sit-in to 7 Oct; no continuation or duration after that date was found, but no end time is stated.

location.summary: Both accounts place the completed 7 Oct action at the Justice Ministry in Cotonou; S007 specifically describes occupation of its courtyard. Public access to that courtyard is not established.

organizer.summary: A collective/college of Justice Ministry unions organized the action; S007 names spokesperson Anselme Kokouvi.

demands.summary: Sources describe labor and administrative grievances, including allowances/fuel allocations, personnel management, status rules and other benefits, addressed to the Justice Minister; S007 also records an appeal to the president.

participants_original.summary: No participant number or descriptive estimate published.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither occurrence report provides event-specific attendance. The number of affiliated unions or ministry staff is not a simultaneous event count; >=50 remains unproven.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is described; keep unknown.

state_response.summary: No event-specific state response is described in the opened report.

notes: Open web sources confirm occurrence and a domestic government target, but not the codebook threshold or whether this in-ministry sit-in was an accessible public gathering. Work stoppage and protest demands are related; no evidence of violence. A strict threshold reviewer may reject absent headcount.
open_questions: Did at least 50 people participate simultaneously?
Was the sit-in in an area functioning as a public forum or only an internal workplace setting?
Did the sit-in end on 7 Oct or continue?
What response, if any, did the Justice Minister make after the motion?
Do contemporaneous records or images establish a simultaneous crowd of >=50?
Was the ministry courtyard open to the public, or was this an internal workplace action?
